# LyricTap

LyricTap is an iPhone and iPad lyric synchronization application. It makes editable line-timed lyrics, offers full-song AI Auto-Sync, multilingual AI lyric translation, bilingual LRC/SRT/TXT and video export, and separated vocal/instrumental track downloads on iOS. The free browser studio uses **manual** syncing and processes selected audio locally. The browser studio does not upload audio or render MP4 videos.

## Accuracy notes
- Browser: manual lyric timing, LRC/SRT/TXT, local audio processing, no account needed.
- iOS/iPadOS app: full-song AI Auto-Sync uses paid credits; AI translation becomes available for successful full AI syncs, with editable line translations and no additional AI sync credit for translating.
- iOS/iPadOS app: original, translated or bilingual lyric files; lyric videos in 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 and 3:4 with configurable lyric colors and outlines.
- iOS/iPadOS app: separate vocal and instrumental track downloads after full AI sync, before temporary links expire.
- Player and ordinary videos show line-by-line sync; manual word timings are for original-language ASS/Enhanced LRC file export.
- LyricTap is not affiliated with Suno or Udio; downloaded audio files can be imported manually.
- Format support depends on the destination player or subtitle renderer.

## Website privacy
- https://569001773-wq.github.io/lyrictap-support/website-privacy/ — browser-only editing, local storage and optional analytics status.

AI Auto-Sync uses paid credits in the iOS app. The free browser tool performs manual line timing only. No official Suno or Udio affiliation. This file is a navigation aid, not an indexing or citation guarantee.
